summary: This class explains the custom of reading Torah, Zohar, and Tehillim in the Beit Evel to elevate the Neshama of the deceased. It describes how Hahamim read from the Idra Rabba, Idra Zuta, and Hadrat Zekenim, leading to the Qirayat with Minha, Arbit, and Divre Torah. It also discusses when the Qirayat takes place during mourning periods.
